name: Recursive Reconstruction Coupling Registry
purpose: Define bounded recursive interactions between reconstruction structures without implying self-complete closure.

coupling_classes.definition: Recursive interaction resulting in the stabilization of shared accessibility structures.
Interaction where recursive feedback maintains or clarifies mandatory projection tensions.
Coupling that strengthens the source-relation trace through consistent multi-aspect feedback.
Recursive interaction that accelerates semantic or topological drift away from the source neighborhood.
Interaction where feedback leads to the failure of the stabilization structure or identity collapse.

mandatory_constraints.statement: Recursive interaction does not imply self-complete description.

governance_rules.rule: Every coupling class must identify its primary feedback mode and closure risk.
Claims of 'recursive closure' or 'self-completeness' trigger immediate REJECT_ESCALATION.

forbidden_claims: Recursive coupling proves that the system is 'self-aware'.
Coupling feedback derives physical self-organization constants.
Interaction stability justifies the assumption of a closed ontology.
